title: Financial Assistance Terms: Hardship Approval and the Patient Payment Plans Setup Fee
content:
A hardship approval recorded on the patient's Patient Financial Account reduces the signing setup fee of a Patient Payment Plans plan by a hardship share.

**Term.** The hardship share of the setup fee is 0.60 when the financial account holds a hardship approval of at least 50 percent whose approved-through date is on or after the signing date; it is 0.80 when the account holds an approval above 0.00 but below 50 percent that is still current on the signing date; and it is 1 when the account holds no current approval. The share multiplies the tier's setup fee within the scheduled setup fee, acting on the tier's setup fee itself; the scheduled setup fee is carried unrounded until the fee is entered.

**Records read.** The approved hardship percentage and the approved-through date on the Patient Financial Account.

**Combinations.**

| Approved hardship percentage | Approved-through date compared with the signing date | Hardship share |
|---|---|---|
| 50 or more | On or after | 0.60 |
| 50 or more | Before | 1 |
| Above 0.00 and below 50 | On or after | 0.80 |
| Above 0.00 and below 50 | Before | 1 |
| 0.00 (no approval) | Any | 1 |

**Boundaries (hypothetical).**

- An approval of exactly 50 percent current on the signing date is at least 50 percent: the share is 0.60. An approval of 49.99 percent current on that date gives 0.80.
- An approval running through the signing date itself is current on that date; one that ran through the day before is not, and the share is 1.

**Figure (hypothetical fee).** On a hypothetical tier setup fee of 40.00, a share of 0.60 alone makes the scheduled setup fee 24.00.
